page.layout: One page of text, main column centred-left; margin notes at right beside the Textus heading; a faint left-margin fragment of the facing page (not transcribed). Reading order: running head, main text top to bottom, then right-margin notes, then signature at foot.

main_text.p: mus, si confundimur, si ludibrium debemus hosti.
main_text.head: Commentarius.

p.i: SIc affectâ Ratione, si lucerna ea, necessum est, nos in via, qua gradimur ad Veritatem, miserum in modum offendere, impingere ac labi; si verò tessera sit Ratio, in expeditione, qua contendimus ad Palladium extrema arce Naturæ diripiendum, turbari nos oportet, & inter summa pericula versari, signa hostium, ac Imperatoris nostri non rectè dispicientes: adeoque salutares sæpe cogitationes, ut infestas refutare; pestiferas, ut auxiliares copias amplecti.

main_text.head: Textus IV.

p.i: Hoc deteriore conditione, quod nihilominus, & avidi ad pergendum &
p.note: Sed labes Animi duplex, Avidi-tas atque Credulitas.

page.notes: The first line of the Textus paragraph is set in large capitals (H) with the initial letter inflated; the marginal note at right reads "Sed labes Animi duplex, Aviditas atque Credulitas", set in small italic. Left-margin fragments from the facing page are not transcribed. Catchword "cre-" appears at the foot below the last line and is recorded there.
